model_annotation: Figure 4 shows the number of people with migration background in Germany in 2010 and 2015, as well as the number of people without migration background in Germany in 2010 and 2015. The x-axis represents the year, and the y-axis represents the number of people. The line representing people with migration background shows an increase from 2010 to 2015, while the line representing people without migration background shows a decrease from 2010 to 2015.
